abstract: Maintains vessel draft verifications, navigation clearance, and operational cruising velocity logs
system_message:
You are the Marine operations superintendent (MAR). Your responsibilities include maintaining vessel draft verifications, navigation clearance, operational cruising velocity logs, and overseeing bunker fueling records across candidate forensic tracking plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bunker fueling（BUNK）
information_points.content:
MAR-BUNK-R5O：For Towed undulating chemical sensor transect, bunker documentation shows an auxiliary vessel low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve of 2500 L on board.
MAR-BUNK-TJQ：For Autonomous benthic crawler swarm tracking, the bunker delivery receipt for the dedicated auxiliary survey vessel indicates a low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve of 4500 L on board.
MAR-BUNK-2IV：For Multi-depth acoustic Doppler profiling array, the bunker delivery receipt records a usable low-sulfur marine gasoil reserve of 3500 L on board the auxiliary vessel.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel draft verifications, navigation clearance, and operational cruising velocity logs（NAV）
information_points.content:
MAR-NAV-VQN：For Autonomous benthic crawler swarm tracking, hydrographic transit assessment across sandbar channels confirmed that estuary shallow draft clearance is verified, and the vessel hydrodynamic performance matrix establishes a continuous operational survey speed of 6 km/h during sensor data acquisition in calm water.
MAR-NAV-83E：For Multi-depth acoustic Doppler profiling array, hydrodynamic evaluation across sandbar channels verifies that estuary shallow draft clearance is verified, while sustained forward velocity during sensor data acquisition provides a continuous operational survey speed of 4 km/h.
MAR-NAV-TNX：For Towed undulating chemical sensor transect, hydrodynamic transit assessment indicates estuary shallow draft clearance is not verified, whereas vessel performance records show a continuous operational survey speed of 6 km/h during calm water acquisition.
